spec.description: What Kepler Geospatial Maps Plus adds, and how many dashboards here need it (the Plus folder, from Grafana's search).

options.content:
Kepler Geospatial Maps Plus

Every sensor, site and vehicle on the map, each with its own time series.

Plus draws each one where it is, together with its series: a sparkline card over the station, a gauge that fills over the substation, a bus that moves with its trail. Press play and the whole map walks through the time range, in step with the rest of the dashboard. It runs the free panel with everything it does, and adds to it.
